Command.Comment: RAGIN CORE live runtime cert metadata

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
echo RUN_TLS_DIR
if [ -d /run/ragin/tls ]; then
  echo DIR=/run/ragin/tls
  find /run/ragin/tls -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | head -n 200
else
  echo DIR_MISSING=/run/ragin/tls
fi
echo CERT_PUB_ONLY
for f in /run/ragin/tls/server.crt /run/ragin/tls/ca.crt /run/ragin/tls/client.crt /run/ragin/tls/*.crt /run/ragin/tls/*.pem; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    echo FILE_PUB=$f
    openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates -ext subjectAltName,extendedKeyUsage,keyId,authorityKeyIdentifier -in "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo PARSE_FAIL=$f
    echo FINGERPRINT_SUM=$(openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo fingerprint_failed)
    echo SIZE_BYTES=$(stat -c %s "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo stat_failed)
  fi
done
echo KEY_LIST_ONLY
for f in /run/ragin/tls/*.key /run/ragin/tls/*.pem; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    echo KEY_FILE=$f
    echo KEY_SIZE_BYTES=$(stat -c %s "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo stat_failed)
  fi
done
echo DONE
